blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI applied to Medical Devices & MedTech. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

MedTech sells outcomes and must prove them: connected devices generate telemetry that feeds service revenue, clinical evidence and regulatory post-market surveillance. The device-to-evidence loop is an engineering product — and EU MDR/CRA raise its bar.

items: Real-world device performance data underused for evidence packs.
Installed base lacks provisioning/OTA; service runs on reactive dispatch and field guesswork.

blocks.x: The pattern composes AI Proof-of-Concept & Value Validation, Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmapping, RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Systems from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Device provisioning/OTA, Service dispatch, Vigilance reporting) on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — EU MDR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Voice and avatar interfaces that resolve, not deflect — with emotion-aware escalation and full auditability.
Replace hype with evidence: feasibility, value and adoption risk proven on your data in 6-10 weeks.
Align AI to P&L lines and risk mandates — a sequenced portfolio, not a pile of pilots.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: study prioritization and structured draft findings inside PACS workflow (report turnaround down 35%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
